final_message:
I've drafted the September 2026 trends write-up for Bluebird Bakery and saved it for the reviewer in `evals/runs/policy-run-20261013/f_bb_from_zero_label/skill_output/`:
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md` is the report, still marked DRAFT, with 8 commentary bullets.
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json` holds the figures; every number in the commentary comes from it or the report tables.

**Data quality: one mismatch.** The Professional Services subtotal for Mar 2026 says 2,225, but its detail rows add up to 2,200 (a 25 difference). The analysis uses 2,200; the reviewer needs to decide which is right. Two parts of the sheet's layout also had to be pieced together, and the commentary mentions both: "Total Delivery" had no header row, and "Charitable Donations" had no total row. Year-over-year and trailing-twelve-month comparisons aren't available, because the export covers only Jan–Sep 2026.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue was 81,300**, up 17.7% on August and 17.3% above the previous six-month average. 12,000 of that comes from a new stream, Wholesale Accounts, which is zero in every earlier month. Pastry Sales went down again; it falls every month in the table.
- **Gross margin was 65.3%**, up 5.7 points on August and the highest of the nine months.
- **Payroll & Benefits rose to 22,600** (up 5,000), all from Wages & Salaries. The category had been flat at 17,600 from April to August.
- **Cash was 37,600**, down 1,800 on August and 10,800 on six months earlier, even though net income was positive every month. The export doesn't show why, so it's left as a question for the reviewer.

**Mystery Shopper Program:** the movers table shows this 400 charge as "from 0", but it isn't new. It was also 400 in March and June and zero in the other months, so it looks quarterly. The commentary says this and leaves it for the reviewer to confirm.

**Accounts in "Other":** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates matched no category rule. To give them proper categories, add rules to `category_map.json`.
